
 Usage: openajar environments [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

 Your agents' cloud computers: list, show, download, close, allow, set up,
 connect repositories.

╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --home        <path>  OPENAJAR_HOME (default: $OPENAJAR_HOME)                │
│ --help                Show this message and exit.                            │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ list         Environments of this node: state, title, repository, machine,   │
│              cost so far, time left.                                         │
│ show         One environment: its machine, lanes, the calls its agent made,  │
│              and its unsaved work.                                           │
│ replay       Write the replay of an environment's browser to a folder, also  │
│              after its VM is gone.                                           │
│ close        Close an environment; refused while its work is not pushed,     │
│              unless --discard.                                               │
│ download     Copy a file or a folder off an environment's machine into DIR,  │
│              without the agent.                                              │
│ saves        The saved environments: what each save holds and what its       │
│              snapshot costs a month.                                         │
│ forget       Forget the saves of a title (or one save), and delete their     │
│              disk snapshots at the provider.                                 │
│ save-export  Write one save to a file, to move it to another node            │
│              (`save-import` there).                                          │
│ save-import  Add a save from another node's `save-export`; an agent resumes  │
│              it with its title.                                              │
│ allow        Set the limits that bound the environments agents open.         │
│ setup        Check what environments need on this node, and say what is      │
│              missing.                                                        │
│ prepare      Build the repository's prepared machine now, and show its       │
│              steps.                                                          │
│ resume       Resume a saved environment now, held by no chat, and give its   │
│              live view.                                                      │
│ repo         Connect private repositories: a key or token in the vault, and  │
│              the declaration for env.                                        │
│ secret       API keys the app in an environment uses: the machine holds a    │
│              placeholder, and the node puts the value in for the bound host  │
│              only.                                                           │
│ machine      Bring your own machine: environments open as containers on a    │
│              Linux box of yours, over ssh.                                   │
│ env          The app's local env files on an environment's machine: plain    │
│              settings copied, secrets bound as placeholders, and the rest    │
│              never sent.                                                     │
│ prepared     The repositories' prepared machines (an image with their setup  │
│              run), and the warm pool.                                        │
│ login        Logins an environment's browser signs in with, from the vault:  │
│              bind them to computers by title, repository or all. `openajar   │
│              environments login TITLE SITE` signs one in now.                │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
